name: Twisted Jack
source: Pathfinder #161: Belly of the Black Whale

items.name: Dagger
items.description: This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

items.name: +2 Greater Striking War Razor
items.description: A war razor is an exaggerated version of the barbers' tool. It is a brittle but extremely sharp weapon that is very easy to slip into a pocket or sleeve.

items.name: +2 Resilient Studded Leather Armor
items.description: This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

offensiveAbilities.name: Bloody Mayhem
offensiveAbilities.description: Twisted Jack Strides three times. Once per Stride, he can attempt a war razor Strike against a creature in his reach at any point during the Stride; he must make each Strike against a different creature, but he doesn't apply his multiple attack penalty until after making all his Strikes. If any of the Strikes are a critical failure, Bloody Mayhem immediately ends.

offensiveAbilities.name: Close Cutter
offensiveAbilities.description: Whenever Twisted Jack deals slashing damage, the target takes an additional 2d10 persistent bleed damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fan of Daggers
offensiveAbilities.description: Twisted Jack makes three ranged dagger Strikes, each against a separate target; he ignores the multiple attack penalty until after making all three Strikes. On a critical hit, the target takes 2d10 Bleed Damage damage and is Blinded for 1 round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Knife Thrower
offensiveAbilities.description: Twisted Jack's ranged dagger Strikes have a range increment of 20 feet instead of 10 feet.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Twisted Jack deals an additional 3d6 precision damage to Off-Guard targets.
